name: Bounty Hunter
ability: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]
setup: One Townsfolk (not the Bounty Hunter) is evil and learns so (token turned upside down). Not applied if only a Drunk believes they are the Bounty Hunter.
wakes: First night; on other nights only if the player marked Known died since they were learned.
interaction: The Storyteller marks an evil player with Known and points to them. The Bounty Hunter learns only that the player is evil, not their character. No choice.
drunk_or_poisoned: May be shown a good player as Known; they then learn a new player on the night that shown player dies.

jinxes.text: If the Philosopher gains the Bounty Hunter ability, a Townsfolk might turn evil.

rulings.text: Can never learn the same evil player twice.
The evil Townsfolk created at setup may be the player the Bounty Hunter learns.
A Drunk-as-Bounty-Hunter gets info as normal but no evil Townsfolk is created.
Kazali jinx (Kazali not on these scripts): if the Kazali turns the Bounty Hunter into a Minion, no evil Townsfolk is created.

test_scenarios.name: first night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bounty Hunter, Bob Imp, Carol Poisoner, Dave Chef (evil Townsfolk from setup).
test_scenarios.expected: Alice is shown one of Bob, Carol, Dave; that player gets Known.

test_scenarios.name: known dies
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bounty Hunter, Known on Carol Poisoner; Dave evil Chef; Bob Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice wakes and learns a different evil player (Dave or Bob); never Carol again.

test_scenarios.name: known alive, no wake
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bounty Hunter, Known on Carol (alive).

test_scenarios.name: poisoned when relearning
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bounty Hunter poisoned by Carol Poisoner; Known was Fred Baron who died; Gina Magician good.
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller may show Gina; Alice next learns a player on the night Gina dies.

test_scenarios.name: drunk bounty hunter
test_scenarios.setup: Eve is the Drunk believing she is the Bounty Hunter; Bob Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: No Townsfolk is made evil; Eve is shown a player (may be good).

test_scenarios.name: philosopher jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Phil Philosopher; Bob Imp; Dave Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: A Townsfolk such as Dave may turn evil; Phil learns an evil player.
